no_adcom_quote.quote: The Division did not obtain the advice of the Oncologic Drug Advisory Committee (ODAC) or Special Government Employees (SGEs) for this NDA. There were no controversial issues that would benefit from advisory committee discussion.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for the KOSELUGO (NDA213756) review. The Multidiscipline Review states in its Advisory Committee Meeting section that the Division did not obtain the advice of the Oncologic Drug Advisory Committee (ODAC) or Special Government Employees because there were no controversial issues warranting such discussion. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
